paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness bundle: Agent Reach skill - one-command internet reach for DSH agents (web, YouTube
, GitHub, Twitter/X, Reddit, RSS, Exa search) via the Agent Reach CLI
# dsh-agent-reach
**One-line value:** install this and every DeepSeek Harness agent gains one-command internet reach —
web reading, YouTube, GitHub, Twitter/X, Reddit, RSS, Exa semantic search, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu an
d more — via the Agent Reach CLI.
> **How it differs from MCP bundles:** Agent Reach is a CLI capability layer + agent skill, **not**
an MCP server. This bundle therefore registers an **in-process DSH skill** (`ctx.skills.register`) i
nstead of an `mcp-client` row — the skill teaches the agent to install the CLI on first use and driv
e its upstream tools (yt-dlp, gh, opencli, twitter-cli, bili-cli, mcporter/Exa, feedparser).
## What it adds to every agent on the profile
| Row | Module | Purpose |
| `agent-reach-skill` | `dsh-agent-reach` (this bundle's own module) | Registers the `agent-reach` s
kill in the DSH skill registry — install guide, health checks (`agent-reach doctor`), optional chann
els (cookies/proxy/keys), and the full upstream command reference |

**Capability category:** 工具与能力 (Tools & Capabilities)
**License:** MIT · **Compatibility:** DSH ≥ 0.
2.0-rc.2 (skills service); agent-reach CLI needs Python ≥ 3.10
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or in **Settings → Plugin Market** (DSH Plugin Hub), search for `dsh-agent-reach`.
After install, restart or re-apply, then ask any agent: *"use the agent-reach skill to give yourself
internet access"* — it will install the CLI and run `agent-reach doctor`.
## Requirements & permissions

- The **skill** itself is self-contained (no runtime deps beyond DSH)
- The **CLI** is installed by
the agent on first use: Python ≥ 3.10 (+ pipx or venv); core channels (web, YouTube, GitHub, RSS, Ex
a search, V2EX, Bilibili) are free and keyless; optional channels (Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Fac

ebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Boss直聘) need cookies/login and your explicit approval
- Cookies stay loc

al in `~/.agent-reach/`; nothing is uploaded
- Upstream tools are re-selected upstream when platform
s break — you don't maintain them
## Publish / uninstall
Push updates to the GitHub repo and bump `"version"`; hub users get update prompts. Remove from the
profile `bundles` + `dependencies` to uninstall.
## Credits
Upstream project: Panniantong/agent-reach (MIT) — this bundle only packages its skill for the DeepSe
ek Harness skill registry.
